description: This file defines a static class 'DbConnectionFactory' responsible for creating and caching database connections using different providers based on invariant names. It includes methods for retrieving factory instances, creating connections, and managing provider type mappings, with support for multiple database systems such as SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.

classes.name: DbConnectionFactory
classes.description: A static class that manages the creation and caching of database connection objects based on provider invariant names.

classes.name: DbConnectionFactory.CachedFactory
classes.description: A nested class representing a cached database provider factory along with its metadata.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Retrieves a cached factory instance for a given invariant name, loading and instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a new database connection for a specified provider invariant name and connection string.
